rows.label: qst703101_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm getting more and more depressed,
mo...

rows.label: qst703101_msg0003
rows.name:
If I don't take it back soon, my
partner will get mad at me, mo...

rows.label: qst703101_msg0005
rows.name:
Please listen to Dodon's troubles,
mo!

rows.label: qst703101_msg0006
rows.name:
As you can see, Dodon makes a living
as a salvager, mo.

rows.label: qst703101_msg0007
rows.name:
I'm salvaging off Lasqam Harbor with
Wood Cylinders, searching for a
certain treasure, mo.

rows.label: qst703101_msg0008
rows.name:
But all I find is junk-like
collectibles, mo...

rows.label: qst703101_msg0009
rows.name:
It must be these lousy Wood
Cylinders' fault, mo.

rows.label: qst703101_msg0010
rows.name:
I heard salvagers in Superbia use
amazing cylinders called Silver
Cylinders...

rows.label: qst703101_msg0011
rows.name:
Dodon wants to try salvaging with
a great cylinder like that too, mo.

rows.label: qst703101_msg0012
rows.name:
...So I have a favor to ask of you,
travelers, mo.

rows.label: qst703101_msg0013
rows.name:
Please collect Apple Lamps and
Steel Lamiboard for me, mo.

rows.label: qst703101_msg0014
rows.name:
Then I'll make a Dodon-style Silver
Cylinder and get that treasure
in style, mo!

rows.label: qst703101_msg0015
rows.name:
As a reward, I'll give you the Bat
Hinges Dodon worked hard to collect
...not the leftovers, mo!
